definition: to pursue wild animals for food or sport
description: A huge dinosaur crouches at the muddy edge of a jungle river below a tall waterfall and lowers its head to drink. Under the brown water a giant crocodile glides straight towards the camera with its jaws closed. The crocodile explodes out of the shallows in a wall of spray and locks onto the dinosaur, which rears up on its hind legs with the thrashing crocodile hanging from it. A wide shot shows more crocodiles cutting through the water towards the struggle.

de.answer: Die Krokodile jagen einen riesigen Dinosaurier.
de.question: Was jagen die Krokodile?

es.answer: Los cocodrilos están cazando un dinosaurio enorme.
